source.title: Some open problems on radial distribution of Julia sets for meromorphic functions

trace.notes: Normalized one URL source, https://zbmath.org/5210747, as a zbMATH resolver record. The source URL is not itself a readable technical full-text artifact.

Failure mode: blocked_or_challenged at the zbMATH web interface, followed by metadata_only resolver recovery. A direct fetch of https://zbmath.org/5210747 returned an HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenge. The zbMATH REST API identified the exact work as 'Some open problems on radial distribution of Julia sets for meromorphic functions' by Sheng Wang, zbMATH id 5210747, identifier 1134.30319, in Proceedings of the 12th international conference on finite or infinite dimensional complex analysis and applications, pages 405-412 (2005), but exposed no full-text links.

Bounded exact-work recovery used exact-title searches, exact-title-plus-PDF searches, ISBN searches for 978-4-87378-899-9 / 4-87378-899-4, and proceedings-title PDF searches. Inspected candidates were rejected because they were the Kyushu University Press catalog/contents page, Japan Search metadata stating no digital content, CiNii and Finna library-holdings records, or different related papers rather than a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements.
Mapping was skipped because no readable PDF or full HTML primary source for the exact work was recovered.

No candidate questions were extracted because source adequacy failed: resolver metadata, catalog contents, holdings records, abstracts, search snippets, and related papers are not acceptable technical evidence under the workflow contract.
Saved failure JSON to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-5210747.json and outputs/latest.json.
